About Us

About AfA-SIFF

AfA-SIFF stands for Art for Advocacy Social Impact Film Forum. It is a Nigerian film forum — not a festival — built to use African cinema, storytelling, music, and stage performance to generate honest discussions around real social issues affecting our communities.

We spotlight African stories that challenge society, inspire reflection, encourage dialogue, and promote change. Through film screenings, panel discussions, humanitarian recognition awards, and community conversations, we confront real African realities: corruption, silence, waste, migration pressure, family values, leadership, and identity.

AfA-SIFF is proudly based in Abuja, Nigeria. Our films are provided by our creative partner, OtaUmaBen Visuals, on YouTube.

Our Mission

To use African cinema, storytelling, music, and conversations as tools for social impact, cultural preservation, moral reflection, and youth empowerment.

Our Audience

Filmmakers, students, faith communities, NGOs, creatives, policy voices, families, and young Africans hungry for meaningful stories and honest dialogue.

Our Format

Film screenings, panel conversations, musical performances, costume showcases, filmmaker talks, and honest community impact sessions in Abuja.

Mission

Our Mission

To use African cinema, storytelling, music, and conversations as tools for social impact, cultural preservation, moral reflection, environmental awareness, and youth empowerment.

Vision

Our Vision

To become one of Africa's leading socially conscious film forums where filmmakers, communities, young people, faith voices, and institutions gather yearly to inspire change through powerful storytelling and honest dialogue.

Our 2025 Panellists

Distinguished voices who brought wisdom, expertise, and passion to our inaugural forum on The Cost of Silence in Abuja.

Nneota Egbe
Media Consultant · Reputation Manager · Channels TV Veteran · John Maxwell Leadership Coach
Nearly two decades anchoring flagship programmes at Channels Television including EcoAfrica, NEWSNIGHT, and Sunrise. A TIMFA-certified marriage coach and member of NIPR and IPI.
Dr. Shola Okpodu
International Development Advisor · Policy Advocate · Certified Trauma-Informed Recovery Counsellor
Over 20 years in communications, advocacy and psychosocial support. Founder of Diary of a Trauma Survivor. Bridges trauma recovery with strategic communication and social change.
Bunmi Saidi
Organisational Development & Governance Specialist · Senior Programme Manager · NGO Leader
Nearly 20 years supporting public sector reform and programme delivery. Founder of The Discovery Mentorship Initiative — building confidence, purpose, and leadership in young people.
'Tunbi Olabisi
Relationship Therapist · Emotional Wellness Expert · CASSON Member
A refined voice in relationship therapy and emotional wellness. Supports individuals, couples, and executives navigating high-pressure lifestyles with warmth, confidentiality, and evidence-based tools.
Chris Madu
Qualified Accountant · Ex-Banker · Corporate Event MC · SME Business Consultant
Over a decade in audit and banking. Experience in corporate training facilitation in finance and entrepreneurship. Runs an SME Business Consulting service and a diction clinic for professionals.
Mr. Mike Abuh Okoh
AfA-SIFF Panellist · 2025 Forum
A distinguished voice at the AfA-SIFF 2025 maiden forum on The Cost of Silence, bringing expertise and passion to community dialogue in Abuja.
Supt. Samaila Bulus
Chief Superintendent of Corrections · Officer In-Charge MSCC, Nasarawa
A senior corrections officer bringing the perspective of justice, rehabilitation, and systemic reform to the AfA-SIFF conversation on silence and accountability in Nigerian society.

AfA-SIFF 2026

THE COST OF WASTE

The 2026 edition focuses on environmental responsibility, waste management, food waste, plastic pollution, climate impact, flooding, and community action — using films, stage performances, and public forum discussions in Abuja.

We invite filmmakers, sponsors, NGOs, climate advocates, volunteers, media partners, and donors to join us in creating a movement through storytelling and honest dialogue.

"Nothing is missing. We just waste everything."

— AfA-SIFF 2026 Theme
